description: This file contains a comprehensive set of unit tests for the PolicyPersistenceActor component in the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests various CRUD operations on policies, policy entries, resources, and subjects, including create, retrieve, update, delete, and recovery scenarios. The tests also validate sequence number correctness, proper handling of size limits, permission validation, and actor supervision behavior.

classes.name: PolicyPersistenceActorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the PolicyPersistenceActor, testing policy CRUD operations, recovery, size limits, and actor supervision behaviors.
